glosses.notes: Describes someone who works steadily and willingly instead of being lazy.

examples.sentence: 大家都说外公年轻时特别勤劳，天还没亮就下地，晚上回来以后还要把第二天的工具都修好。
她从年轻的时候就很勤劳，不管家里有多少事要做，总还是会先把第二天要用的东西都准备好。
孩子以前只觉得父亲忙，后来跟着他过了一个假期，才明白原来勤劳不是嘴上说说，而是每天都肯早起。

example_translations.translation: Everyone says that Grandfather was especially hardworking when he was young. He went out to the fields before dawn and still repaired the next day’s tools after coming back at night.
She has been hardworking since she was young. No matter how many things there are to do at home, she still always prepares everything needed for the next day first.

The child used to think only that Father was busy, but after spending a vacation following him around, he realized that being hardworking is not just something you say, but something shown by getting up early every day.

glosses.notes: Can describe something transparent or pure, and can also mean to make something clear or clear something out.

examples.sentence: 雨停以后，门前那条小河一下清了不少，连水底那些圆石头都能看见，所以孩子一直蹲着不肯走。
这件事要是再不当面说清，后面传来传去只会让家里人越来越着急，到时候谁也说不明白。
母亲把那边的纸一层一层收走以后，窗边那块地方终于清出来了，连下面的灰都能看见。

example_translations.translation: After the rain stopped, the small river in front of the house became much clearer, and even the round stones at the bottom could be seen, so the child kept squatting there and refused to leave.
If this matter is still not explained clearly face to face, all the retelling afterward will only make the family more anxious, and by then no one will be able to explain it properly.
After Mother removed the papers over there layer by layer, the space by the window was finally cleared out, and even the dust below could be seen.

glosses.notes: Refers to the quiet hours just after daybreak.

examples.sentence: 清晨刚亮的时候，母亲已经在厨房里把饭做上了，窗外那条街却还安静得像没有什么人走过。
他习惯在清晨出去跑一会儿，不是为了和别人比快，而是觉得那时候脑子最安静，很多事更想得明白。
山里的清晨来得特别慢，孩子打开窗子的时候，远处的雾还没有散开，树顶只是刚刚见亮。

example_translations.translation: When early morning had only just begun to brighten, Mother was already in the kitchen getting the meal started, while the street outside the window was still so quiet that it felt as if hardly anyone had passed by.
He is used to going out for a short run in the early morning, not to compete with anyone, but because he feels that his mind is calmest then and many things become easier to think through.
Early morning comes especially slowly in the mountains. When the child opened the window, the mist in the distance had not yet cleared, and only the tops of the trees had just begun to brighten.

glosses.notes: Refers to a person’s youthful years and the feeling often associated with them.

examples.sentence: 姐姐后来翻看高中照片的时候才发现，原来大家最想留住的青春，不是那几张笑得最好看的脸，而是一起过来的日子。
母亲看见女儿在院子里一边听歌一边晾衣服，忽然笑着说，这种忙里还带着笑的样子最像青春。
那部旧电影里的青春写得不算热闹，更多是几个人挤在小房间里，一边吃面一边商量以后想成为什么样的人。

example_translations.translation: When my sister later looked back through her high school photos, she realized that what everyone most wanted to preserve about youth was not the few faces smiling best, but the days they came through together.
When Mother saw her daughter listening to music while hanging clothes in the yard, she suddenly smiled and said that this kind of busyness that still carries a smile felt most like youth.

The youth in that old film is not written as especially lively. It is more about a few people squeezed into a small room, eating noodles while discussing what kind of people they want to become later.

glosses.notes: The stage when a child is developing into a teenager and both body and emotions often change quickly.

examples.sentence: 医生说孩子到了青春期以后，饭会一下吃得更多，情绪也很容易一下高一下低，这些都不奇怪，家里先别急着只说他不懂事。
母亲回头看女儿的青春期照片，才发现那时候最难的不是功课，而是很多话想说又不知道该怎么开口。
老师带青春期的学生久了以后，最怕的不是他们顶嘴，而是明明心里难受，却一直说自己什么事都没有。

example_translations.translation: The doctor said that after a child enters adolescence, it is not unusual for them to start eating much more and for their emotions to swing up and down very easily, so the family should not rush to say only that he is being immature.
When Mother looked back at photos from her daughter’s adolescence, she realized that the hardest part then was not schoolwork, but having many things to say while not knowing how to begin.
After teaching adolescent students for a long time, what the teacher fears most is not that they talk back, but that they are clearly hurting inside while still saying that nothing is wrong.

glosses.notes: Usually describes food, flavor, or color that is not heavy, greasy, or strong.

examples.sentence: 医生让父亲这几天先吃得清淡一点，别看人刚好一些，就又去碰太油太辣的东西。
这家小店的汤面味道虽然清淡，但是天冷的时候喝上一碗，人会从胃里一直暖到手上。
母亲最近晚上做饭都很清淡，不是怕花钱，而是家里两个老人一吃太油的菜，夜里就睡不好。

example_translations.translation: The doctor told Father to eat a lighter diet for the next few days and not to go straight back to greasy or spicy food just because he has started feeling a little better.
The soup noodles at this small shop have a mild flavor, but when the weather is cold, one bowl warms you from your stomach all the way to your hands.
Lately Mother has been cooking light dinners, not because she is afraid of spending money, but because if the two older people in the family eat oily dishes, they do not sleep well at night.

glosses.notes: Describes an environment or surface as neat, sanitary, and free from dirt.

examples.sentence: 这家小旅馆虽然很旧，但是床单、地面和窗台都保持得很清洁，所以姐姐住进去以后反而很放心。
孩子小时候总觉得医院的味道太重，后来长大一点才明白，人一进去就会安静下来，其实和环境清洁很有关系。
母亲挑那家饭店，不是因为它地方大，而是因为里面看起来一直很清洁，连角落里的桶都摆得整整齐齐。

example_translations.translation: Although this small hotel is old, the sheets, floor, and windowsills are all kept very clean, so my sister actually felt reassured after checking in.

When he was little, the child always felt that hospitals smelled too strong. Only after growing older did he understand that the fact people calm down as soon as they go in has a lot to do with how clean the environment is.
Mother chose that restaurant not because it was large, but because the inside always looked very clean, with even the buckets in the corners arranged neatly.

glosses.notes: Used for removing, sorting, or cleaning away things that have built up.

examples.sentence: 下雨以后家里进了不少水，父亲和几个人花了整整一上午清理地面，才把还能用的东西都搬出来。
姐姐搬家以前先把自己的东西清理了一遍，结果本来只想收拾半小时，最后却一直看到天黑。
那条小路两边的草长得太快，村里只好临时找人清理，不然孩子们晚上回家时很容易看不清脚下。

example_translations.translation: After the rain, a lot of water got into the house, and Father and several people spent a whole morning cleaning the floor before they could move out all the things that were still usable.
Before moving, my sister first cleared out her own things. She had planned to tidy up for only half an hour, but ended up going on until dark.

The grass on both sides of that small road was growing too fast, so the village had to find people to clear it out temporarily. Otherwise, it would be easy for children not to see where they were stepping when walking home at night.

glosses.notes: To sweep or thoroughly clean an area by removing dust, leaves, trash, or other debris.

examples.sentence: 天还没亮的时候，门口那个人已经开始清扫门前的路了，所以大家上班出门时，地上已经很干净了。
演出散场以后，几个学生留下来帮老师清扫教室，连最后一排椅子底下那些纸也一张一张捡出来了。
昨天晚上风太大，院子里落了满地的叶子，父亲吃完早饭就去清扫，怕一会儿下雨以后更不好收拾。

example_translations.translation: Before it was even light out, the person at the entrance had already started sweeping the road in front of the door, so by the time everyone left for work, the ground was already very clean.
After the performance ended, several students stayed behind to help the teacher sweep the classroom, even picking up the papers under the last row of chairs one by one.
The wind was very strong last night and left leaves all over the yard, so after breakfast Father went out to sweep, afraid that if rain came later, it would be even harder to clean up.

glosses.notes: To listen with real focus and care, not just to hear the words.

examples.sentence: 孩子一开始只是想把自己的委屈说完，后来发现老师真的在倾听，他反而慢慢把最重要的话说出来了。
母亲说，跟老人说话的时候，光点头还不够，得真的坐下来倾听，才知道他反复提起的到底是哪件事。
那场分享会最打动姐姐的，不是台上人说得多好，而是台下有人一直安静倾听，等别人说完才慢慢问问题。

example_translations.translation: At first the child only wanted to finish telling his grievance, but after realizing that the teacher was really listening attentively, he slowly began to say the most important things.
Mother says that when speaking with older people, nodding is not enough. You have to truly sit down and listen attentively before you understand which matter they keep bringing up again and again.

What moved my sister most at that sharing session was not how well the speaker on stage talked, but that someone in the audience kept listening attentively in silence and only asked questions after the other person had finished.

glosses.notes: Used for washing or rinsing something carefully until it is properly clean.

examples.sentence: 雨天走回来以后，母亲先让孩子把鞋放到门外，再接水慢慢清洗，不然泥一带进去，家里就更乱了。
老板把那台旧机器送去清洗以后，里面积了很久的灰和油才总算被弄出来，声音也没有以前那么大了。
这家店的人每天关门前都会把杯子和东西仔细清洗一遍，所以第二天一开门，里面总是亮亮的。

example_translations.translation: After walking home on a rainy day, Mother first has the child leave his shoes outside the door and then slowly wash them with water, because if the mud gets carried in, the house becomes even messier.
After the boss sent that old machine to be cleaned thoroughly, the dust and oil that had built up inside for a long time were finally removed, and it no longer sounded as loud as before.
Every day before closing, the people at this shop carefully wash the cups and other things once, so when the door opens the next morning, the inside always looks bright and clean.

glosses.notes: Describes something as sharp, easy to distinguish, or easy to understand.

examples.sentence: 父亲把那张旧照片放大以后，孩子才第一次清晰地看见年轻时的奶奶，连她脸上的笑都看得很明白。
医生说，恢复到什么程度不能只靠感觉，得把每天的变化记得清晰一点，后面看起来才不会乱。
广播里那段说明原来听着有点快，可是老师又放了一遍以后，重点一下就清晰多了，连最后那句提醒都没人再漏掉。

example_translations.translation: After Father enlarged that old photo, the child could for the first time see his grandmother clearly when she was young, even down to the smile on her face.
The doctor said that you cannot judge recovery only by feeling. You have to record the day-to-day changes more clearly so that things do not become confusing later.

At first that section of explanation on the broadcast sounded a little fast, but after the teacher played it once more, the key points suddenly became much clearer, and no one missed the final reminder again.

glosses.notes: Can mean to lean toward a choice or habit, or the tendency itself.

examples.sentence: 孩子一到紧张的时候就倾向先不说出来，所以老师每次提问，都会先给他一点时间再等他开口。
母亲买东西一直有个很明显的倾向，就是先看东西能不能用很久，好不好看反而放在后面。
医生说，他这几天有点倾向夜里咳得更厉害，所以药先别停，再看两天是不是会慢慢好一点。

example_translations.translation: Whenever the child gets nervous, he tends not to say things right away, so each time the teacher asks a question, she gives him a little time before waiting for him to speak.
Mother has always had a very obvious tendency when buying things: she first looks at whether something can be used for a long time, while whether it looks nice comes afterward.

The doctor said that over the past few days he has tended to cough more seriously at night, so the medicine should not be stopped yet; they should watch for two more days to see whether things slowly get a little better.

glosses.notes: Can describe being mentally alert and sober, or the moment of waking into full awareness.

examples.sentence: 闹钟响了两次以后，姐姐人才算真正清醒，坐下来先喝了点水，才想起今天最早那场会几点开始。
父亲说，越是别人都着急的时候，自己越得保持清醒，不然一个小决定做错了，后面会更难补。
孩子发烧那晚一直没有睡好，直到天快亮的时候才清醒过来，开口第一句就是想喝点热水。

example_translations.translation: Only after the alarm rang twice did my sister become truly clear-headed. She sat down, drank a little water first, and only then remembered what time the earliest meeting started.
Father says that the more everyone else is panicking, the more you need to stay clear-headed. Otherwise, if one small decision is made wrong, it becomes much harder to fix later.
The child did not sleep well that night with a fever and did not fully wake up until dawn was nearly there. The first thing he said was that he wanted some hot water.

glosses.notes: Refers to the sequence of events in a story, film, or drama.

examples.sentence: 这本书前面看着很平常，可是情节一转到那封旧信上，姐姐就一下坐直了，连水凉了都没顾上喝。
孩子看电影的时候总爱先问后面的情节，可是真等母亲说出来一半，他又怪人家把最好看的地方提前讲了。
老师让我们写看完这本书以后的想法，不是只把情节再说一遍，而是想看看大家到底记住了哪一处最让人停下来想很久。

example_translations.translation: The beginning of the book looked quite ordinary, but as soon as the plot turned toward that old letter, my sister sat up straight and did not even remember to drink her water before it turned cold.
The child always likes to ask about the later plot while watching a movie, but once Mother has really revealed half of it, he complains that she spoiled the best part too early.

The teacher had us write what we thought after finishing the book, not just retell the plot once more, but show which part everyone remembered as the one that made them stop and think for a long time.

glosses.notes: Describes bright, open weather with good light and little or no cloud cover.

examples.sentence: 天气一变得晴朗，院子里晒着的被子和衣服就都很快干了，所以母亲总爱挑这种天洗大件。
山里的天一到下午忽然晴朗起来，远处的房子、树和路一下都亮了，连刚才那层薄雾也慢慢退开了。
这几天一直下雨，孩子早上拉开窗一看见这么晴朗的天，连饭都比平时吃得更快，只想早点出去跑。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the weather turns sunny, the quilts and clothes drying in the yard dry very quickly, which is why Mother always likes to wash larger things on days like this.
When the mountain weather suddenly cleared up in the afternoon, the houses, trees, and roads in the distance all brightened at once, and even the thin layer of mist from earlier slowly pulled away.
It had been raining for days, so when the child pulled open the window in the morning and saw such sunny weather, he ate even faster than usual and wanted only to get outside and run.

glosses.notes: Refers to how things are at a particular time or in a particular place.

examples.sentence: 父亲到店里的时候一看那边的情形，就知道今天肯定要忙到很晚，因为门口等的人已经排到街边了。
老师先问清楚宿舍里的情形，才决定要不要马上给家长打电话，因为有些事一急反而更容易说乱。
母亲回家一推开门，看见家里的情形先停了一下，随后才发现原来是孩子想自己收拾桌子，结果越收越满。

example_translations.translation: As soon as Father looked at the situation there when he arrived at the shop, he knew he would definitely be busy until very late, because the people waiting at the door were already lined up to the side of the street.
The teacher first asked clearly about the situation in the dormitory before deciding whether to call the parents right away, because some things become even easier to explain badly if people panic.

When Mother pushed open the door after coming home and saw the situation at home, she paused for a moment before realizing that the child had tried to tidy the table by himself and ended up making it fuller and fuller instead.

glosses.notes: A written-style verb for seeking, requesting, or aiming for something.

examples.sentence: 父亲说这次修房子先不求快，只求后面一下大雨的时候，家里人晚上能安安心心地睡。
姐姐去那家小店买礼物的时候，不求东西有多贵，只求送出去以后，老人一眼就知道她是认真挑过的。
老师讲这道题的时候提醒我们，写答案别只求对，还要求自己把前后为什么这样想清楚。

example_translations.translation: Father said that in repairing the house this time, they were not seeking speed first. They only wanted the family to be able to sleep peacefully when heavy rain came later.
When my sister went to that small shop to buy a gift, she did not ask for it to be expensive. She only wanted the older person to know at a glance that she had chosen it with care.

While explaining this problem, the teacher reminded us that when writing an answer, we should not only seek to be correct, but also require ourselves to understand clearly why we thought that way from beginning to end.

glosses.notes: To ask someone to marry you.

examples.sentence: 朋友后来回忆那次求婚，最紧张的不是把话说出来，而是刚把准备好的东西拿出来时，手一下就乱了。
姐姐原来以为求婚一定得去很大的地方，后来看到那对人只是在家里吃完饭安静地说出来，反而觉得更真。
父亲知道他想求婚以后，没有先问戒指多贵，而是先提醒他，后面日子怎么过比那一刻更重要。

example_translations.translation: When my friend later remembered that marriage proposal, what made him most nervous was not saying the words, but that once he took out the thing he had prepared, he immediately started fumbling with his hands.
My sister used to think that a marriage proposal had to happen in a very grand place, but after seeing that couple simply speak it quietly at home after dinner, she felt it was more genuine instead.

After Father learned that he wanted to propose marriage, he did not first ask how expensive the ring was. Instead, he reminded him that how the days would be lived afterward mattered more than that single moment.

glosses.notes: To call out or reach out for urgent help in a dangerous or difficult situation.

examples.sentence: 车刚开到半路的时候突然坏了，父亲先把孩子带到路边安全的地方，再打电话向朋友求救。
那只小猫掉进墙后面的时候一直在叫，孩子原来以为它只是害怕，后来才听出那声音像在求救。
老师说，真有危险的时候，最要紧的不是觉得不好意思，而是先大声求救，让边上的人快点过来。

example_translations.translation: When the car suddenly broke down halfway there, Father first brought the child to a safe place by the roadside and then called a friend for help.
When the little cat fell behind the wall, it kept crying. At first the child thought it was only scared, but later he realized the sound was really a cry for help.
The teacher said that when there is real danger, the most important thing is not feeling embarrassed, but crying out for help loudly first so that the people nearby come over quickly.

glosses.notes: To look for work or apply for a position.

examples.sentence: 姐姐第一次出去求职的时候，把简历来来回回改了很多遍，连照片放左边还是右边都想了很久。
父亲说，年轻人求职最怕的不是被问住，而是明明没听懂问题，却为了显得镇定一直乱答。
那场说明会来了很多正在求职的人，所以门口一开，大家先找的不是座位，而是写着公司名字的那张表。

example_translations.translation: When my sister applied for a job for the first time, she revised her resume over and over again and even thought for a long time about whether the photo should go on the left or the right.
Father says that what young people fear most when applying for jobs is not being asked a hard question, but not understanding the question and still answering wildly just to appear calm.

A lot of people in the middle of a job hunt came to that information session, so when the door opened, what everyone looked for first was not seats, but the sheet with the company names written on it.

glosses.notes: To ask another person or group for practical help or support.

examples.sentence: 孩子发现电脑里的作业怎么也打不开以后，先没有乱按，而是拿着本子去办公室向老师求助。
母亲说，真到顾不过来的时候要早点求助，不然一个人硬撑到最后，家里外面都会一起乱起来。
那位老人刚搬来时连路都不熟，后来愿意开口向别人求助以后，买东西、看病这些事就慢慢好办了。

example_translations.translation: After the child realized that the homework on the computer would not open no matter what, he did not start pressing things randomly, but took his notebook to the office and asked the teacher for help.

Mother says that when things truly become too much to handle, you need to ask for help early. Otherwise, if one person keeps forcing themselves to endure it alone, everything at home and outside will begin to fall into disorder.

When that older person first moved in, he was not even familiar with the roads. After he became willing to ask other people for help, things like buying necessities and going to the doctor gradually became easier to handle.

glosses.notes: To tell two things apart by noticing their differences clearly.

examples.sentence: 老师讲这两个词的时候，没有让我们只背意思，而是拿了三个句子出来，帮大家慢慢区分它们用的时候哪里不一样。
姐姐挑布料的时候很会区分手感和颜色，可是父亲看来看去只觉得都差不多，最后还是让她来决定。
医生说，孩子夜里是因为冷醒还是因为咳醒，要先区分清楚，不然药和被子都可能用错地方。

example_translations.translation: When the teacher explained these two words, she did not have us memorize only the meanings. Instead, she brought out three sentences to help everyone slowly differentiate where they are used differently.
When choosing fabric, my sister is very good at distinguishing texture and color, but Father only feels that they all look more or less the same and ends up letting her decide.

The doctor said that you first have to distinguish clearly whether the child wakes up at night because of cold or because of coughing. Otherwise, both the medicine and the blanket could be used in the wrong way.

glosses.notes: A route or means through which goods, information, or opportunities move.

examples.sentence: 这家小店原来只有一个进货渠道，所以一到天气不好或者路上出事，架子上常有几样东西会先空下来。
父亲找工作的那几个月，把能用的渠道都试过了，老同学、旧同事和网上那几个平台一个也没落下。
老师说，现在孩子听歌看消息的渠道太多，所以更得学会先分清什么是真的，什么只是别人随手发的。

example_translations.translation: That small shop originally had only one supply channel, so whenever the weather turned bad or something happened on the road, a few items on the shelves would run out first.
During the months when Father was looking for work, he tried every channel available, from old classmates and former coworkers to the online platforms, without leaving any of them unused.

The teacher said that children now have too many channels for listening to music and reading news, so they need even more to learn how to tell what is real and what was just casually posted by someone else.

glosses.notes: A song, melody, or musical piece, often counted with 一曲 when speaking about one performance or tune.

examples.sentence: 外面刚安静下来，街口那个老人就拉起一曲老歌，连准备关门的人都站住听完才走。
孩子学琴最开心的时候，不是把一曲弹得一点不错，而是终于能听出里面哪一段在慢慢往上推。
婚礼快开始时，姐姐临时换了一曲更轻一点的音乐，因为她怕前面那首太满，反而压住了大家说话的声音。

example_translations.translation: Just after things outside had gone quiet, the old man at the street corner started playing an old song, and even the person about to close up stopped to listen until the end.
What makes the child happiest while learning the instrument is not playing a tune without a single mistake, but finally being able to hear which part inside it is slowly pushing upward.
Right before the wedding began, my sister temporarily changed to a lighter song because she worried that the earlier one felt too full and would overpower everyone’s voices.
